User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores core details for authenticating customers and administrators, including current role, state, and accumulated rewards coins.

avatar.description: URL to the user profile avatar photo.

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of last successful authentication.

CartItem.title: Cart Entry
CartItem.description: An item in the user's active shopping cart, including selected customization options.

id.description: Unique composite identifier of the cart item (productId + options).

selectedColor.description: Color name chosen by the patron.

selectedSize.description: Size name or code chosen by the patron.

selectedMaterial.description: Material quality chosen by the patron.

Favorite.title: Favorite Product
Favorite.description: Stores a product identifier that has been added to the user's wishlist.

productId.description: Core product identifier favorited by the patron.

Order.title: Customer Order
Order.description: Represents a purchase invoice with real physical and virtual state transitions.

itemsCount.description: Sum of total unit quantities in the order.

ReturnRequest.title: Return Case
ReturnRequest.description: Patron request to return customized crochet goods or services due to weave issues.

orderId.description: Reference of the origin purchase invoice.

/users/{userId}.description: Authentic profiles of Len Handmade clients and administrators.

/users/{userId}/cart/{itemId}.description: Active shopping cart storage, synchronized when authenticated.

/users/{userId}/wishlist/{productId}.description: Wishlist products specified by the user.

/returns/{returnId}.description: Return applications submitted by customers for admin analysis.
